text: My wheat leaves have yellow stripe rust and are curling. What should I do?
My rice crop has brown spots with grey centres on the leaves — looks like blast disease.
I see small caterpillars inside my cotton bolls. They are destroying the crop.
My tomato plants have curling leaves and the fruits are small. The plants look weak.
My sugarcane stalks show red discolouration inside when cut. The plants are wilting.
My paddy plants are pale yellow starting from the lower leaves. Soil looks poor.
Meri soybean ki patiyon par bahut chote keede hain jo ras choos rahe hain.
My onion crop has purple or violet spots on the leaves with yellow halos.
Majhya makkyachya khodyat kide ahet ani paan peetsar hotat.
My groundnut leaves have dark brown circular spots with yellow halos — is this tikka disease?
My banana plants have yellowing and wilting leaves starting from the outer leaves inward.
My chilli fruits have dark sunken spots and are rotting on the plant before harvest.
